items.title: WNBA Champ Jewell Loyd Is Committed to Giving Back to Her Community Off the Court
items.why: Las Vegas Aces guard Jewell Loyd discussed her off-court ventures, including a family office and a coffee truck, at an F1 Las Vegas event.
